title: Phetchaburi temple uses UFO to teach dharma
excerpt: A temple in Phetchaburi has used a spaceship as a platform for a sermon during the Loy Krathong festival this year, marking a novel departure from the usual look of merit-making events.
content:
A temple in Phetchaburi has used a spaceship as a platform for a sermon during the Loy Krathong festival this year, marking a novel departure from the usual look of merit-making events.

Wat Bandai Thong said the spaceship symbolised a journey without limits, much like the Buddha’s teachings, which have travelled across time and place for thousands of years and continue to reach people around the world.

In a message on its Facebook page, it said bringing creativity and novelty into a religious event did not alter the essence of Buddhism. Rather, it was meant to spark interest, offer new perspectives and draw younger people closer to the religion.

The temple said the Buddha wanted his teachings to spread for the benefit and happiness of many people, and that dharma should not be confined to temples and communities but be passed on or modernised to reach the wider society.

“A spaceship might take us to far-away planets. But Buddha’s teaching can take our mind to peace and freedom from suffering,” the message said.

The spaceship was merely a vehicle made by humans, it said, while dharma was a vehicle of wisdom.

What mattered most was not the form used to spread Buddhism, it said, but keeping its teachings alive in people’s hearts and passing them on to future generations.
